propositions: Recursive tests/**/conftest.py in global_support incorrectly selects all seven mutation shards for any nested conftest change, despite pytest loading only six ancestor conftests per shard.
Runtime tracing confirmed pytest loads only upward conftests (not sibling trees), so unrelated nested fixtures like tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py never affect test execution.
Over 97 Verify runs, seven proven over-trigger candidates consumed 322.6 runner-minutes (5.38 hours) without increasing coverage.

Per-shard conftest mapping (tests/unit, tests/interfaces, tests/interfaces/store, tests/scripts, tests/scripts/reducer to their dependent shards only, with tests/conftest.py remaining global) eliminates false triggers while retaining all 374 passing tests and fixture dependencies.

Contract test test_manifest_conftest_support_matches_selected_test_ancestry validates exact ancestor-conftest closure derivation, pins all pre-existing mappings, and kills defect-seeded mutations (missing dependency, stale entry).
Unrelated nested conftest changes (e.g., tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py) must select zero shards, and each declared ancestor conftest must select only its dependent shards.
